quotes.text: The 2024 address book color cleanup shortened local variable names to --ab-* and reused shared list, sidebar, selected-item, and focus tokens. It also removed duplicate button defaults already in common.css. Current address book still uses --ab-* for its own dimensions and icon color, while shared tree-listbox uses light-dark and forced-colors branches. For new address book styling, inspect current shared tokens before adding local colors or duplicating a common rule.
